meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后,只在涉及 Git 提交或历史调查的任务时,Claude 会先检查仓库状态,再按你的请求拆分提交、执行变基、定位代码改动来源,并给出命令证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 Git 历史时触发(例如查某行是谁改的、某个改动何时引入);普通代码编辑不会触发,除非你明确要求。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动提交,按功能分多个提交。
say.note: 会查看diff,按逻辑拆分并逐个提交。

say.text: 查一下这个文件里这行是谁改的。
say.note: 会运行git blame并给出提交哈希和作者。

say.text: 把最近三个提交合并成一个。
say.note: 会执行rebase并保留消息风格。

howto.what_en: Once installed, only for Git commit or history-investigation tasks, Claude first checks repository state, then splits commits, runs rebases, traces where code changes came from, and shows command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task needs to commit code or investigate Git history (e.g., who changed a line, when a change was added). Ordinary code edits won't trigger it unless you explicitly ask.

say_en.text: Commit these changes as separate commits by feature.
say_en.note: Inspects diff and commits each logical group.

say_en.text: Who last changed this line in this file?
say_en.note: Runs git blame and shows commit hash and author.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Runs rebase and keeps the message style.
